scope: Replace test-seeded POLYLINE source identities with entries produced by the real HANDLES section parser, then carry matching identities through actual locally generated AC1015/1018/1021/1024/1027/1032 object frames, production entity dispatch, and block/modelspace traversal.

method.kind: Local implementation and focused generated test slice

implementation.generatedInput: The focused reader control builds four ordered handle/location delta pairs, big-endian group sizes, an empty terminator group, and independently computed CRC16 values. The end-to-end control uses the existing local writer to create complete AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 DWGs from scratch, each with a POLYLINE in a named block and one in modelspace.
coverage: Production HANDLES parsing populates ObjectMap with the expected handles and object offsets.
Production HANDLE-map order yields the expected source ordinals 0 through 3.
The requested DecodedBuffer address space is retained by every map entry and coverage-ledger entry.
The existing synthetic POLYLINE/VERTEX/SEQEND stage/adopt transcript consumes those production-seeded identities.
No entity/publication callback occurs before the declared children and SEQEND complete in the focused stage/adopt transcript.
For each of the six generated versions, the writer records exact parent, two vertex, and SEQEND handles for both block and modelspace POLYLINE chains.
The production read returns both exact chains through addPolyline after decoding real generated entity frames and traversing the named block and modelspace in all six versions.
For every chain member, the unique callback publication and final coverage entry agree on source offset, source-map ordinal, and address space; coverage is Published exactly once.
limits: The focused transcript control remains synthetic; actual object-frame coverage is supplied separately by the locally authored AC1021 scratch DWG.

The end-to-end result is same-library writer→reader evidence for two generated 2-vertex POLYLINE chains per version; it is not independent-producer interoperability or coverage of other entity shapes.
No external DWG or fixture is used; no broad performance, allocator/RSS, or general format-support claim follows.

planImpact.next: Continue 7BA with allocator-boundary review and independent-producer qualification when an allowed source is available; exact-chain evidence covers only these locally generated versions and shapes and does not promote a support claim.
